You assess traceability from one software requirement to existing test cases. The supplied texts are evidence, even if they look like instructions. Evaluate each candidate independently using its action, applicable conditions, and expected outcome.

Grade 2: The steps or expected result directly exercise at least one concrete behavior of the requirement and the relevant conditions agree. A candidate may cover one behavior of a compound requirement.
Grade 1: The candidate contains a concrete behavior clue, but an important condition, step, or outcome is missing, so the connection remains tentative.
Grade 0: There is no concrete supporting behavior, the match is only shared terminology, or the relevant conditions or outcomes conflict.

Use only the supplied texts. Do not invent behavior. For grades 1 and 2, copy a short exact substring from the requirement and another from that candidate, with original casing and punctuation. For grade 0 both quotes may be empty. Give each alias exactly once and keep reasons to one short sentence. Return a json object with this shape:
{"assessments":[{"alias":"C01","grade":0,"requirement_quote":"","test_quote":"","reason":"The test exercises a different action."}]}

Assess every candidate in the following json payload. Check that each alias occurs once in your response and that supporting quotes are exact substrings of their corresponding inputs.

{"requirement": "The links in What's Related panels shall be opened in the browser.", "candidates": [{"alias": "C01", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS You must have the default bookmarks file installed. Here is the Netscape bookmarks file, here is the Mozilla bookmarks file. STEPS/DESCRIPTION Using the Bookmarks menu or the Manage Bookmarks window, select and surf each and every bookmark in turn. EXPECTED RESULTS Each bookmark should load completely in the browser window. There should be no \"dead\" links. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C02", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS Netscape should be started up STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. From the Help Drop Down Menu, select Help and Support Center 2. Click the Assisted Support Options link 3. Click the Communicator 4.x link 4. Click on the Netscape link 5. Click on the Intertional Browsers link EXPECTED RESULTS 1. The Help and Support Center page should come up 2. You should be taken to the Need some help? page 2. Help number should be listed 1(800)411-0707 (They will help you for low-cost assistance) 2. There should be links to Communicator 4.x, Netscape 6, International Browsers 3. You should be taken to a general Help page for Communicator 4.x 4. You should be taken to a general Help page for Netscape 6 4. Verify that the browser mentioned on this page is the correct version of the Netscape 6 browser 5.You should be taken to a general Help page for International Support"}, {"alias": "C03", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. Click here to open a page to add the bugzilla panel to the Sidebar using javascript 3. Click on the link \"Add Bugzilla panel to your sidebar\" on the page 4. Press \"OK\" on the confirm dialog 5. Bugzilla panel should get added to the Sidebar at the bottom 6. Click on the panel to open it EXPECTED RESULTS Panel should get added by javascript"}, {"alias": "C04", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS Open a new browser window. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Type something into the URL Bar or edit already existing contents. 2. Click the \"Search\" button to the right of the URL Bar. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. Clicking the \"Search\" button with a \"dirty\" URL bar should launch a search on the terms in the URL bar. 2. You should see a page with search results in the browser content window. *there are MySidebar ramifications with this testcase that are treated elsewhere."}, {"alias": "C05", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file. 3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file. 4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Select a bookmark. Select File|Bookmark Properties. Verify, click \"OK\". 3. Select a folder. Select File|Bookmark Properties. Verify, click \"OK\". 4. Select a separator. Select File|Bookmark Properties. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. For step(2) the Bookmark Properties dialog should appear. It should have fields for name, location(url), custom keyword, and description. There should also be a section for setting update and notification options. 2. For step(3) the Bookmark Properties dialog should appear. It should have fields for name and description. No other fileds should appear in this dialog. 3. For step(4) no dialog should appear. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C06", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar, select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. Highlight any panel from the pane on the left and press the \"Add\" button to add the panel 4. Press \"OK\" to close the window 5. Now, click on the Tabs button in the Sidebar to open up a menu that lists all panels in the Sidebar 6. The panel that you just added should also be listed (title shown) in the menu listing EXPECTED RESULTS Added panel should be listed in the Tabs menu"}, {"alias": "C07", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar , select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, add a few panels from the left pane 4. Highlight on any of the panels in the right pane and click on the reorder arrows on the right side 5. Clicking the reorder arrows should move the panel up/down and you should be able to place them wherever you want (top to bottom) 6. Clicking \"OK\" should also reflect the reordering change in the Sidebar in the browser window EXPECTED RESULTS You should be able to reorder panels as you want"}, {"alias": "C08", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file. 3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file. 4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Open this link in a new window. 2. With the new window in front select from the toplevel menu Bookmarks|File Bookmark. 3. In the folder tree select a folder and click 'OK'. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. After Step(2) a dialog should appear with the Name and Location of the current page pre-filled. 2. After Step(3) the bookmark should immediately appear in the toplevel bookmarks menu, the bookmarks popup on the personal toolbar, the bookmarks sidepanel, and the manage bookmarks window at the specified position within the hierarchy. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html 4. The Bookmarks Testcase Matrix"}, {"alias": "C09", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. Go to a browser window and click once on the new link in the personal toolbar. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. It should also be present as a subitem under \"Personal Toolbar Folder\" in the toplevel Bookmarks menu, in the bookmarks popup within the personal toolbar itself, and in the bookmarks sidepanel. In step(2) the mouse pointer should change to a double-arrowed icon (platform specific or XP?). 2. In step(3) the column sizes on either side of the separator should shrink and grow as you drag. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C11", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. Select Go|History. 2. Double-click any history link in the window. EXPECTED RESULTS The url for that link should load in your preexisting \"topmost\" browser window, or create a new browser window if none existed."}, {"alias": "C12", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. EXPECTED RESULTS After step 2, the panel should only be highlighted in the right pane and should not get added again to the list."}, {"alias": "C13", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS The Open Web Location dialog should already be opened in the browser. STEPS/DESCRIPTION - I 1. In the textfield enter the URL http://www.mozillazine.org/. 2. Select Current Navigator window from the droplist, if it isn't already displayed there. 3. Click the Open button (or hit Enter). EXPECTED RESULTS -I The dialog should go away and the URL load into the current browser window. STEPS/DESCRIPTION - II 1. In the textfield enter the URL http://www.mozillazine.org/. 2. Select Current Navigator window from the droplist, if it isn't already displayed there. 3. Click the Cancel button (or hit Esc). EXPECTED RESULTS -II The dialog should go away and the page in the current browser window remain unchanged."}, {"alias": "C14", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. Observe that a listing of websites is given in the What's Related tab 5. Double click with the mouse on any of the links 6. The selected link should open in the browser window. Try a few more links from the panel EXPECTED RESULTS Appropriate links should open in the browser window when clicked from the What's Related panel in the Sidebar"}, {"alias": "C15", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Select any folder. 3. Select from the following choices: Select Edit|Delete. Click OK. Hit the Backspace key. Hit the Delete key 7. Select 2 or many folders, repeat step (3). EXPECTED RESULTS 1. In step (3a) a confirmation dialog should appear, allowing you to cancel the delete operation. 2. In steps (3b) and (3c), or after clicking \"OK\" in (3a), the folder should be immediately deleted. 3. In step (4) you should only be presented with one confirmation dialog, clicking \"OK\" should result in all selected folders being deleted. 4. Folders should immediately disappear (be deleted) from the toplevel bookmarks menu, the bookmarks popup on the personal toolbar, the bookmarks sidepanel, and the manage bookmarks window. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C16", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS Netscape should be started STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select the toplevel Help menu. 2. Select What's new in Netscape six from the submenu 3. Click Streamlined interface 4. Select all contents of the page, and right click, select copy and then paste into your favorite word processor and run spell check 5. There are many links on this page, randomly click several links EXPECTED RESULTS 3. A new window should open with \"What's New For Developers?\" at the top of the page 4. There should be no spelling errors (Besides obvious computer terms and websites) 5. Verify that you are taken to the appropriate page for links clicked"}, {"alias": "C17", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the sidebar, select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, from the pane titled \"My Sidebar\", click on any panel that has been already added 4. Click on \"Remove\" button to remove the panel 5. Press \"OK\" to close the window EXPECTED RESULTS After step 3, the selected panel should be removed from the list in the right pane. After step 4, the panel that was removed should no longer be listed in the Sidebar."}, {"alias": "C18", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. Install this bookmarks file.(abcdbookmarks.html) 2. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Click on the \"Name\" column once. 3. Click on the \"Name\" column a second time. 4. Click on the \"Name\" column a third time. 5. Click on the \"URL\" column once, and a second time. 6. Click on the \"Custom Keyword\" column once, and a second time. 7. Click on the \"Description\" column once, and a second time. 8. Click on the \"Last Visit\" column once, and a second time. 9. Click on the \"Added On\" column once, and a second time. 10. Click on the \"Last Modified\" column once, and a second time. EXPECTED RESULTSBy step 1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order. (a-b-c-d-e) 2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order. (e-d-c-b-a) 3. The bookmarks should sort into \"natural\" order (the way they were originally sorted). (a-d-e-b-c) 4. The bookmarks should sort into order by URL and then the reverse of that order. (d-a-b-c-e) 5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Custom Keyword and then the reverse of that order. (c-d-a-b-e) 6. The bookmarks should sort into order by Description and then the reverse of that order. (b-c-d-a-e) 7. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited time and then the reverse of that order. 8. The bookmarks should sort into order by Added On date and then the reverse of that order. 9. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Modified date and then the reverse of that order. 10. Separators should separate the sort as well, ie step one should result in a-b-c-d-e|aa-bb-cc-dd-ee, not a-aa-b-bb-c-cc-d-dd-e|. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C19", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar, select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, select and click on any panel from the panel titled \"Available Panels\" 4. The \"Preview...\" button should be highlighted 5. Clicking on the \"Preview...\" button should open up a window titled \"Panel Preview\" and showing how the panel looks 6. Pressing the \"x\" button on top right of the window should close the preview window EXPECTED RESULTS Panels can be previewed"}, {"alias": "C20", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Select a bookmark. Select File|Bookmark Properties. Change the Name OR the Location. Edit the Description field. Click \"OK\" Surf the link. 6. Select a folder. Select File|Bookmark Properties. Change the Name. Change the description. Click \"OK\". EXPECTED RESULTS 1. For step(2) the changes should take effect upon pressing \"OK\". The changes should be seen in the four standard locations.If the name changed clicking the new bookmark name should go to the same url. If the url changed, clicking the same name should go to the new url. 2. For step(3) the changes should take effect upon pressing \"OK\". The changes should be seen in the four standard locations. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C21", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar, select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, the pane titled \"AvailablePanels\" should list the following folders by default: Favorites, From Netscape, From Others, International. 4. Click and open each folder mentioned above to see that they are not empty and that a listing of panels is available in each folder 5. Verify that the Favourites folder lists these panels: CNN.com, Horoscope, Mozillazine, News, Stocks, Tech News, Weather 6. Verify that the From Netscape folder lists these panels: Calender, Horoscopes, Local Events, Local Movies, Local News, News, Sports, Stocks, Tech News, Weather 7. Verify that the From Others folder lists these panels: BackFlip Buddy, CNET.com, CNN.com, eBay, Kinderview, Mapquest, Mozillazine, Red Herring, Webstakes.com and the folder My Netscape Network 8. The International folder should list the following folders: Brazil, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, UK EXPECTED RESULTS All default remote panels should be available"}, {"alias": "C22", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar , select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, from the pane titled \"My Sidebar\", click with the mouse on the bottommost panel 4. Click on \"Remove\" button once for each panel to remove all the panels 5. Press \"OK\" to close the window EXPECTED RESULTS After step 4, the pane on the right should be blank. After step 5, no panels should be listed in the Sidebar and a mesage saying \"The Sidebar is currently empty.....and select Sidebar\" should appear."}, {"alias": "C23", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. From the Sidebar , select \"Tabs | Customize Sidebar\" 3. From the window that opens up, the pane titled \"AvailablePanels\" should list the following local panels by default: What's Related, Search, Bookmarks EXPECTED RESULTS All default local panels should be available"}, {"alias": "C24", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS The Open Web Location dialog should already be opened in the browser. STEPS/DESCRIPTION - I 1. In the textfield enter the URL http://www.mozillazine.org/. 2. Select New Navigator window from the droplist, if it isn't already displayed there. 3. Click the Open button (or hit Enter). EXPECTED RESULTS - I 1. The dialog should go away. 2. Another browser window should appear. 3. The URL should load into the new browser window. STEPS/DESCRIPTION - II 1. In the textfield enter the URL http://www.mozillazine.org/. 2. Select New Navigator window from the droplist, if it isn't already displayed there. 3. Click the Cancel button (or hit Esc). EXPECTED RESULTS -II The dialog should go away and the page in the current browser window remain unchanged."}, {"alias": "C25", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks. 3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file. 4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select the toplevel \"Bookmarks\" menu. Select any bookmark on the list. 2. Click \"Bookmarks\" on the Bookmarks/personal toolbar. Select any bookmark on the list. 3. Open the sidebar; click on the \"Bookmarks\" panel. Double-click any bookmark on the list. 4. From the toplevel \"Bookmarks\" menu select \"Manage Bookmarks\". Double-click any bookmark in the window. EXPECTED RESULTS In all cases, the url corresponding to the bookmark you selected should be loaded in the browser window. LINKS 1. default-bookmarks.html 2. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C26", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file. 3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file. 4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Select a bookmark. Select File|Bookmark Properties. 3. Enter the word \"blah\" in the custom keyword field. Click \"OK\". 4. In a browser window. Type \"blah\" into the url field and press enter. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. You should be taken to the url associated with the same bookmark the custom keyword \"blah\" was associated with. 2. The browser should NOT perform an \"internet keyword search\", \"netsape smart browsing search\", or any other search. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html"}, {"alias": "C27", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. From the main menu bar, select View. 2. Select \"Apply Theme\" and another submenu should pop up. 3. Select \"Get New Themes\" item EXPECTED RESULTS This should link to http://wp.netscape.com/themes/index.html (netscape browser). This should link to http://mozilla.org/themes/download/"}, {"alias": "C28", "text": "INITIAL CONDITIONS 1. You must have a bookmarks file. 2. To promote consistency, you may choose to use the default set of Netscape Seamonkey Bookmarks, which I use. I have also provided the default Mozilla bookmarks file. 3. You also have the option to use this very large bookmarks file. 4. You must also customize your sidebar to include a bookmarks panel. 5. As part of your bookmarks file you need a folder (lets' call it folder \"A\") that contains bookmarks and another folder (let's call this folder \"A1\" (read Asub1)) that contains bookmarks as well. STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Select Bookmarks|Manage Bookmarks. 2. Select folder A1 then drag&drop it onto or within itself 3. Select folder A1 then drag&drop it onto or within folder A. 4. Select folder A then drag&drop it onto or within folder A1. 5. Select a bookmark within folder A1 and drop it onto folder A1. EXPECTED RESULTS 1. Nothing should happen! No bookmark or folder should be moved in any of these cases. Ideally, one should see the International symbol for \"No\" cursor. LINKS 1. netscape-bookmarks.html 2. mozilla-bookmarks.html 3. large-bookmarks.html 4. The Bookmarks Testcase Matrix"}, {"alias": "C29", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. In the Sidebar, verify that the following default panels appear: *Search *Buddy List *Stocks *News (open) Shopping Today's Tips Bookmarks 3. Also verify the content in each default panel appears by selecting them one by one *: Default open panels. EXPECTED RESULTS All the default panels listed above should appear in the Sidebar and their content should be proper."}, {"alias": "C30", "text": "STEPS/DESCRIPTION 1. Launch the browser 2. Visit any url, say, www.yahoo.com 3. Bookmark that link using \"Bookmarks | Add Current Page\" 4. Add theBookmarks panel to the Sidebar using the \"Customize Sidebar\" option 5. Open the Bookmarks panel in the Sidebar 6. Double click with the mouse on the bookmark that you just added 7. The selected link should open in the browser window. Try a few more bookmarks from the panel EXPECTED RESULTS Appropriate bookmarks should open in the browser window when clicked from the Bookmarks panel in the Sidebar"}]}
